snippet.title: Agentic Commerce Has Arrived | Add Shopping to your AI Agent
snippet.description:
We're bringing native shopping into your AI conversations. Use our APIs and MCPs to add shopping capabilities to your agent across a vast merchant ecosystem with hundreds of millions of products. Shopify has you covered from querying for products to showing them to buyers. There's no need to worry about all the ways in which products are sold, such as variants, subscriptions, bundles, or kit configurations. It just works.

Shopify loads the merchant's checkout, combining the customizations they need to run their business with your agent's branding so it feels native to your application. Meeting common compliance requirements is simple, including GDPR, CCPA, PCI DSS v4, and more. And because Shopify handles checkout for you, you shouldn't have to worry about the usual marketplace compliance requirements faced by platforms that handle their own payments.

Explore the updates and request access: https://shopify.dev/docs/agents

snippet.title: Going headless on Shopify | ButcherBox’s principal engineer takes you inside their migration
snippet.description:
Shopify is creating the best possible platform for developers. We do this by constantly releasing new features that make it easier and more fun to build anything you can imagine on Shopify.

But what’s it really like to build on Shopify? To give you an idea, we interviewed David House, Principal Engineer at ButcherBox, one of the leading direct-to-consumer meat brands, about his migration to Shopify using Hydrogen and Oxygen.

Watch this convo to learn how ButcherBox:
• Used a phased approach to migrate to Shopify with a headless solution
• Seamlessly integrated the custom subscription app they built for their previous platform (while preserving their existing member frontend)
• Increased simplicity and conversion rates by switching to Shopify — even though their UX remained the exact same for their customers

Bonus: David shares his recommendations for other developers planning a similar migration.

snippet.title: How one backpacking trip created dozens of jobs and saved over 3 million plastic bottles
snippet.description:
Five years ago, Johannes and Christoph met on a backpacking trip and decided to solve a problem they shared: the weight and waste that went into carrying plastic bottles of shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. Thousands of test recipes later, they launched Duschbrocken and became an example of Germany’s burgeoning startup scene. They now employ 30 people and work with factory partners in Germany and Austria who have been in the soap-making business for centuries. They’re committed to local production and sustainable practices, and have saved the world from three million plastic bottles and counting.

When an entrepreneur starts a business, they may have no idea the impact they will have on their family, employees, communities, suppliers, customers, and the world. But we see it, and we’re measuring it. 

Introducing the Shopify Entrepreneurship Index. Released today in beta and updated quarterly, the Index is a first-of-its kind database that measures the economic impact of Shopify entrepreneurs. All over the world and even in places like Chariton, Iowa, independent businesses are creating jobs and driving their communities forward. Here’s to Jill’s Homestead and all the other hard-working entrepreneurs around the world. 

Learn more at: https://news.shopify.com/index-beta

snippet.title: The Shopify Entrepreneurship Index
snippet.description:
Entrepreneurs are leaders, thinkers and innovators. Individually, they share a drive to build a better life, a better community, and a better world. They’re also the backbone of our global economy. They create jobs. They anchor communities. They give people opportunity beyond their wildest imaginations. 

Up until today, there’s never been a public and global database that measures the economic impact of entrepreneurship. So, we built the world’s first global entrepreneurship index. By tracking this data and regularly updating it, we can see where entrepreneurs are thriving, but perhaps more importantly, where they're not. Giving policymakers, business leaders, and academics, the data they need to make smarter decisions to unleash entrepreneurship. 

This is the Shopify Entrepreneurship Index. Learn more at: https://news.shopify.com/index-beta

They are currently working on building education with creators, if you want to learn more, sign up for their weekly newsletter. 

ABOUT HARLEY FINKELSTEIN
Harley Finkelstein is an entrepreneur, lawyer, and the President of Shopify. Harley grew up being a serial entrepreneur. He founded his first company at age 17 while a student at McGill. Harley completed his law degree as well as his MBA at the University of Ottawa, where he started multiple companies, notably an online licensed tshirt business which led him to being one of Shopify’s first merchants and meeting Tobi Lutke. After graduating law school and finishing articling, Harley moved to Ottawa and joined Shopify as one of the early employees. Today he is the President of Shopify.

snippet.title: What is an NFT? Explained in 59 seconds #shorts
snippet.description:
You’ve probably heard about this thing called an “NFT” but what is it, and why do you need to know about it?
In short, NFT stands for non-fungible token. 
If an asset is fungible it means it can be replaced or exchanged and its value will stay the same. For example, 5 $20 bills have the same value as 1 $100 bill. 
Therefore, non-fungible assets cannot be substituted. These are assets like land, homes, or even baseball cards. Their value is defined by their own unique qualities which can take away, or add value. 
Now those examples are physical.  NFTs are digital assets, or, tokens.

On the day after her wedding, Ann Goody was suddenly hit in the face by lightning in Kailua-Kona, Hawaii. The life-threatening incident left her traumatically autistic and led to years of intensive rehabilitation, including Ann having to learn to walk and talk again. One day, when her husband asked what he could do to help, Ann, still rebuilding her language skills at this point, answered with one word, "zebra." That day, their inspiration for an animal rescue and shelter business was born. 

Today, a rehabilitated Ann and her husband help both exotic and domestic animals find safe homes and heal from injury at Three Ring Ranch. They operate as a, not for profit organization with a focus on education for both present and future animal-loving generations and running their business continues to be therapeutic for Ann as she moves past the trauma of her injury, one day at a time.

What if your customers were demanding a product innovation that might ... burn down your entire business? This is exactly what happened to toy top manufacturer ForeverSpin. Traditionally made from wood, ForeverSpin's customers wanted spinning tops that were lighter and that would spin faster and for longer. For ForeverSpin's founders, the solution was to use magnesium, one of the lightest and - they would soon learn - most combustible and volatile elements in the world. Not long into their first production run of magnesium tops, they found their entire manufacturing facility was on fire. snippet.title: The story of boxing champ Vasyl Lomachenko's favorite boxing gear | My Shopify Business Story
snippet.description:
Being the outsider is hard. For Ben Amanna, it’s been a way of life. 

Born to Indian immigrants in Coventry, England, Ben grew up as one of the few South Asian kids in his neighbourhood. This led to some tough times growing up, but also led him to two things that would define him as an adult: a deep passion for the sport of boxing, and an unwavering will to succeed. 

In 2016, Ben launched BOXRAW, a boxing apparel company from his mother’s basement. Less than 3 years later, he sponsors a world champion, and dreams of competing with the likes of Nike and Adidas. 

A crucial piece on the journey to growing BOXRAW, is the company's partnership with Ukrainian pro boxer, Vasyl Lomachenko, who has become the face of their brand. Lomachenko is a three weight world champion. He held the WBA (Super), WBO and Ring magazine titles since 2018, and previously the WBO featherweight and junior lightweight titles between 2014 and 2018 and is a two time gold medalist, and arguably the greatest boxer to have ever lived.

In this documentary we follow Ben as he travels from sleepy Coventry to New York’s Madison Square Garden where Lomachencko will be fighting Puerto Rico’s Jose Pedraza in an ESPN televised bout. For Lomachenko, it’s a chance to unify his lightweight titles. For Ben, it’s a massive fight that could thrust BOXRAW into the spotlight and give Ben a taste of the big leagues.

snippet.title: We went to Mississippi to visit a hair braiding salon
snippet.description:
In this episode of Beauty Mark, hosts Rachel and Jess visit Tupelo, Mississippi to meet Melony Armstrong, owner of Naturally Speaking Salon, to learn about her soon-to-be-launched haircare line Good Locs. After a trip to an out-of-town salon a few years ago, Melony's damaged hair was instantly revitalized. She realized there was a real opportunity to bring a new type of haircare experience to Tupelo, beginning her journey to open the first natural hair braiding salon in Mississippi. Along this journey, Melony's greatest struggle included a civil rights law suit to change Mississippi state law, in a fight to allow for equal rights for women of color in the pursuit of economic independence. Watch the episode to learn more about how Melony's work has shaped her community.

snippet.description:
